blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor, Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry L. Ridon, on Tuesday questioned the more than P200,000 restaurant bill allegedly charged to the credit card of lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, saying the amount covering a single meal could already feed residents of three barangays. Carpio is the husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, who is facing the Senate impeachment court on allegations of unexplained wealth and nondisclosure of assets. Ridon said the House prosecution is prepared to question the Vice President’s defense witnesses about the credit card transactions when the impeachment trial resumes Nov. 9.
